newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Speedway files for 4.0 mln A shrs.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Speedway files for 4.0 mln A shrs.

text.p: International Speedway Corp filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 4.0 million class A common shares.
The Daytona Beach, Fla.,-based motor sports promoter said it estimates the initial offering price of the shares at between $14 and $16 a share.
It said net proceeds will be used for additional improvements of its track facilities and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through underwriters led by Smith Barney Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 600,000 additional shares.
International Speedway is currently traded as a bulletin board stock. It said it has applied to be quoted on the Nasdaq national market system under the symbol ISCA.O.
